title: “S” Key Does Not Work in iPad App for Saving Items
summary: With iPadOS 27, typing “a’ on a Magic Keyboard no longer saves an item in the iPad app. A hard reset of the iPad doesn’t help nor does removing the iPad from the keyboard and re-attaching it. There’s no other way to save items this quickly on an iPad.
body_markdown:
[NJS](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/NJS)


September 20, 2026, 11:51pm 1


With iPadOS 27, typing “a’ on a Magic Keyboard no longer saves an item in the iPad app. A hard reset of the iPad doesn’t help nor does removing the iPad from the keyboard and re-attaching it. There’s no other way to save items this quickly on an iPad.
